mapper.sql: tenant_id, people_id, engine_code, category, disease_code, snapshot_id, status, level, level_label, tier, score, active, fingerprint, assessed_at, evaluated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO people_assessment_latest( tenant_id, people_id, engine_code, category, disease_code, snapshot_id, status, level, level_label, tier, score, active, fingerprint, assessed_at, evaluated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{peopleId}, #{engineCode}, #{category}, #{diseaseCode}, #{snapshotId}, #{status}, #{level}, #{levelLabel}, #{tier}, #{score}, #{active}, #{fingerprint}, #{assessedAt}, #{evaluatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE tenant_id = VALUES(tenant_id), category = VALUES(category), disease_code = VALUES(disease_code), snapshot_id = VALUES(snapshot_id), status = VALUES(status), level = VALUES(level), level_label = VALUES(level_label), tier = VALUES(tier), score = VALUES(score), active = VALUES(active), fingerprint = VALUES(fingerprint), assessed_at = VALUES(assessed_at), evaluated_at = VALUES(evaluated_at)
INSERT INTO people_assessment_state(tenant_id, people_id, dirty_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{peopleId}, #{at}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE dirty_at = VALUES(dirty_at)
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, people_id FROM people_assessment_state WHERE dirty_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dirty_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO people_assessment_state(tenant_id, people_id, dirty_at, evaluated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{peopleId}, NULL, #{startedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE evaluated_at = VALUES(evaluated_at), dirty_at = IF(dirty_at IS NOT NULL AND dirty_at <= #{startedAt}, NULL, dirty_at)
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, people_id FROM ( SELECT m.tenant_id, m.people_id FROM people_org_membership m WHERE m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.left_at IS NULL AND m.is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT l.tenant_id, l.people_id FROM people_assessment_latest l ) x WHERE x.people_id > #{afterPeopleId} GROUP BY x.people_id, x.tenant_id ORDER BY x.people_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO people_assessment_fact( id, tenant_id, people_id, field_code, value_json, source, submission_id, recorded_at, recorded_by ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{peopleId}, #{fieldCode}, #{valueJson}, #{source}, #{submissionId}, #{recordedAt}, #{recordedBy} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value_json = VALUES(value_json), source = VALUES(source), submission_id = VALUES(submission_id), recorded_at = VALUES(recorded_at), recorded_by = VALUES(recorded_by)
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, people_id, portal, submitted_by, request_id, answers_json, overrides_json, submitted_at FROM assessment_questionnaire_submission WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND people_id = #{peopleId} ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, pk_id DESC LIMIT 1

mapper.select: SELECT FROM assessment_questionnaire_request WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND reminded_at IS NULL AND gmt_created <= #{createdBefore} LIMIT 500
mapper.update: UPDATE assessment_questionnaire_request SET reminded_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id}
